main_text.p: ferât,alia verò perpetuò incoćtilia & cibis dif-ficilia:quin &in eadem interdū segete nonnul-la coćtilia inueniri,alia autem incoćt lia,sulco tantum discernente,mirabile alicui videretur, nifi in victib̃ id quoq; spećtaretur.Coćtile hîc Quid sit dicitur,quod refolui facile potest, & coćturâ fragmentū celeriter immutari: incoćtile contra,q̃ plané coćtile & non vel ægre immutatur:prius molle rarumq; incoćtile? est, caliditatem & humiditatem , quibus re-solutio fit,suscipere valens: alterum sua den-sitate repugnat & resistit:atq; hæc omnia eue-niunt cœli solíque ratione. In Lemno non nisi coćtilia proueniunt , quoniam ager calidus, stercorofus,tenuis,soliq; expositus est. Ægy-ptus cœli soliq; gratiâ coćtilia affert, caliditas enim coćtilitati atq; digestioni perutilis est at-que pnecessaria.Quę igitur agro ferueri & leni Certum proueniunt,coćt lia erunt: quæ algido,spisso, lento,atq; etiam madido & palustri erumpunt solo,incoćtilia sentiuntur omnia,ob vberi? nimirum alimentum val diusq;.nam & frequen-tioribus imbrib. incoćt lia seri constat, & de-teriora,putredinîque magis obnoxia. Pluuia certè à satione protinus secuta incoćt litaté af-fert,Solis siccitas,licet min⁹ reddat suauia. co-ćtilia tamen efficit.Certissimū autę in proban- in probanda disfrumentis & leguminib. experimentū est, quod vnicuique debet esse ad manum , siqui- disfrugib. dem ad vitę salubritatem optimum funda- & legu- mentum:estque huiusmodi.Semina aquâ per- mentum ex fun- perimen-

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are short catchphrases beside the lines and are partly illegible; their readings are doubtful. The ink is faded and the scan is uneven, so several words (notably at the end of lines, and the note 'coćtile &' and 'in probanda', 'disfrugib.', 'mentum ex', 'perimen-') are uncertain. The last line of the page is a catchword-like line of the next page ('perimen-') and is treated as the catchword. The gathering signature 'K 3' is at the foot.
